tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba mus pa chen po yis/ /gang blo rgyas phyir dri ba'i tshul/ /cung zad gnang ba rnams kyi lan/ /rgyal ba dges pa'i mchod rdzas bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ na ma satri rat+na sh+tsa gu ru bh+yaḥ mahā mu tra dharma dha tu bo dha yan+tu/ bod skad du/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi dbyings phyag rgya chen po rtogs par gyur cig gang gi sku ni tshul khrims dri ldan mthong bas yid 'phrog bshes gnyen sku/ /gang gi gsung ni chos kyi char 'bebs thos pas gdung sel snyan pa'i gsung / /gang gi thugs ni bde stong rang bzhin dran pas bde ster zag med thugs/ /gang yang yon tan rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po rgyal/ /kun mkhyen khyod kyis bdag blo rgyas phyir legs bshad cha/ /smra ba gyis zhes bka' stsal thob phyir cung zad bris/ /'di la nongs gang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /khyod kyis bsal nas dri med legs bshad snang ba stsol/ /ces mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin dam pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa'i 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba gang des bdag blo mang du thos pa'i mdzod dang ldan phyir dri ba'i tshul cung zad gnang ba'i lan mdor bsdus phul ba 'di la don gsum ste/ dri ba'i gsung bkod pa/ de'i lan btab pa/ gong ma'i bzhed srol bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyed thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i rgyur 'gro ba gda' bas/ sems dpa' chen po'i lam 'bras kyi khrid yig cig na/ mngon rtogs ljon shing dang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag shar nub kyi ri lta bur go bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi dngos grub 'byung gter du/ skal dman rim 'jug pa'i lam rim gyi skabs su/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/

/zhes pa nas sngags kyi rim pa kun shes kyi bar/ snang ba gsum gyi khrid du 'dus nas/ de rjes kyai rdo rje'i smin byed nas dkri ba ni khyad par ro/ /zhes pa'i snang gsum gyi skabs gang dang gang du skal dman rim 'jug pa'i lam gang dang gang 'du ba gsal kha can blo kha tshim pa zhig 'tshal/ yang dngos grub 'byung gter las/ dbang gcig car du bskur ba dang / rim can du bskur ba zhes pa'i skabs su/ 'on kyang bla ma gong ma rnams rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe dbang gcig car du bskur ba dang / gsung ngag 'chad pa'i tshe dbang rim can pa'i phyag len mdzad zer ba de'i don de la yang thugs gzhig zhig chug mdzod/ ces pa de dag ni dri ba'i gsung bkod pa yin la/ gnyis pa de'i lan btab pa la gnyis te/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsung don bshad pa dang / dngos grub 'byung gter gyi tshig don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsung las mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dang / gsung ngag lam 'bras sbrags nas 'chad dgos par bshad pa de/ gsung ngag dngos bstan nas gsal bar ma gsungs pa'i dbang gis sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blang tshul la/ dbu sems kyi srol gang rung ngam/ brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan nam/ ljon shing gi 'dis kyang chog par bshad pas/ de'i lag len dang / gzhan yang slob ma rjes bzung sogs mdor na nyams myong skyed byed khrid kyi gzhung shing bzhi sogs gsung ngag gi chos skor spyi dang / khyad par ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i gzhung shing gi mgo mjug bar gsum gyi rgyas bshad phal cher ljon shing chen mo na 'dug pas de la dgongs pa 'dra lags/ gnyis pa dngos grub 'byung gter gyi tshig don bshad pa la gsum ste/ rgyud kyi tshig don bshad pa/ de snang ba gsum du 'du ba'i tshul/ dbang rim can dang gcig car ba'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i brgyad pa las/

dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa'i don dge ba gso zhing sdig pa sbyong ba'i bsnyen gnas ston pa ste/ de la'ang thog mar mi rtag pa dang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan bstan te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gror 'jug pa yin te/ de'ang gzhan la bsnyen gnas yod mod kyi/ /skyabs su ma song ba la med/ /ces mdzod nas gsungs pa ltar la bslabs nas/ de nas/ tshul khrims yan lag bag yod pa'i/ /yan lag brtul zhugs yan lag ste/ /bzhi gcig gsum rim go rim bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gso sbyong nyin gcig gi mtha' la brten pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la bslab par bya ba yin no/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /zhes pa'i don mi dge ba bcu spangs pas tshul khrims thams cad der 'du ba'i phyir/ lus kyi las gsum/ ngag gi las bzhi/ yid kyi las gsum ste de rnams spong ba la slob pa'am/ yang na skyabs gsum 'dzin pa/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen te khyim pa'i phyogs lnga dang / tshangs spyod dang / go mi dang / dge tshul dang / bar slob ma dang / dge slong ste rab tu byung ba'i phyogs lnga ste bcu pa de dag la bslab dgos par bstan pa yin no/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /zhes pa'i don ni mdzod nas bshad pa'i shes bya'i gzhi lnga/ gzugs dang / sems dang / sems las byung ba dang / ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed dang / 'dus ma byas dang lnga/ zag bcas dang / zag med dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched dang / bden pa la sogs pa rgyas par dbye ba'i sgo nas thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste/ zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgoms nas 'bras bu byang chub bsgrub tshul ston pa yin no/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i don ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la brten nas ston pa/

chos thams cad sems yin yang / sems snang pa'i dmigs pa rten tsam zhig phyi rol gyi don 'dod pa byung chub sems dpa' sa bcu dang / sku gsum la sogs pa 'dod pa ste/ rgyas bshad mngon pa kun las btus dang / mdzod kyi 'grel pa la zhib tu bslab par bya zhes pa'i don yin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /ces pa'i don ni/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / /de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /zhes chos mngon pa theg pa chen po'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar gyi shes bya'i gzhi bcu'i bsdus pa'i tshul theg pa chen po'i dang lam 'bras bu mtha' dag la slob pa bstan pa yin no/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ lam dang 'bras bu'i gzhi thams cad rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid dang 'dra ba las/ lta ba'i khyad par du byas na sems la sogs pa'i chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin med par ston pa ste/ 'di la 'jig rten grags sde ba dang / bye brag tu smra ba dang tshul mtshungs pa dang / mdo sde spyod pa'i dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma zhes kun rdzob kyi 'dod tshul mi 'dra pa lnga yod kyang / don dam par ni rang bzhin med cing brjod pa dang bral ba nyid kho nar ston pa sogs theg chen bka' dang bstan bcos rab 'byams la slob ces pa'i don yin no/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ legs grub dang / dpung bzang la sogs pa bya rgyud dang / rnam snang mngon byang dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang / de nyid bsdus pa sogs rnal 'byor rgyud dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bde mchog sgyu ma sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud de rgyud sde de rnams la rim par bslabs nas shes par bya zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa don de dag snang ba gsum du 'dus tshul bstan pa ni/

tshig rkang dang po'i don ni/ sbyor ba skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba gdab/ /dngos gzhi rang rang dmigs pa nyams su blangs/ /rjes ni dge ba bsngo zhing dran shes brten/ /zhes pa'i sa bcad gsum pa 'dir phal cher 'dus shing / zhib par las 'bras kyi skabs su 'dus par 'dra lags/ tshig rkang gnyis pa'i don ni/ blang dor ston pa dkar nag las 'bras khrid kyi skabs su 'dus par sems shing / tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i don yang gtso cher las 'bras kyi skabs su ka 'dus pa 'dra lags/ tshig rkang lnga pa'i don ni/ lhag bsam bskyed pa nyams kyi snang ba'i khrid kyis/ /zhi gnas bsgom dang lhag mthong bsgom/ /de nyid zung 'brel bsgom pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i lhag mthong sgom pa'i skabs kyi gsal ba ngos bzung / mtha' bral blo bzhag dang / brjod bral la nges shes bskyed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i gsal ba ngos bzung ba yan chad du 'dus shing / tshig rkang drug pa'i don ni/ thog mar skyabs 'gro nas bzung / brjod bral la nges shes bskyed pa'i bar dang / spro ba bskyed pa dag pa'i snang ba'i khrid de snang gsum gyi mgo mjug thams cad du 'dus par go lags/ tshig rkang bdun pa'i don ni/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi'ang 'thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas su gcig pa'i phyir/ dag pa'i snang ba'i khrid/ 'bras bu de thob 'dod kyi blo skyed byed yin pas na/ skabs der zhen yul gyi 'bras bu gcig pa'i cha nas 'dus par bzhed pa 'dra zhing / 'on kyang cung zad go dka' bar mchis lags/ gsum pa dbang rim can pa dang gcig car ba'i don bshad pa ni gsung ngag 'chad pa'i tshe/ dbang rim can pa'i phyag len mdzad zer ba de/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong chos drug rim gnyis bsgom pa'i go rim la mang du yod pa'i/ 'phags pa yab sras dang / sems 'grel ba rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas/ rdzogs rim bsgom par bshad pa dang mtshungs par 'dra lags shing /

gsung ngag nyid las kyang / nyams snga ma ma skyes par phyi mar mi spo/ zhes pa dang yang mthun par sems lags/ rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe gcig car ba'i phyag len mdzad pa de/ dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs dus gcig la bskur nas/ rgyud bshad yongs rdzogs nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba la dgongs pa 'dra ste/ rgyud bshad la dum bur gcod mi rung bar rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar du gsal ba ltar yin pa 'dra lags/ spyi don gsum pa gong ma'i bzhed srol bkod pa ni/ gso sbyong nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes kyi bar snang gsum du 'dus tshul 'di la/ mkhar spe rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyis/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la dri ba zhus pa'i tshig ni/ 'di ltar te/ dri ba bcu pa mkhas mchog smra seng gi gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od kyi kha skong las/ bya rgyud nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i bar snang ba gsum du bsdus nas nyams su len par gsungs shing / rgyud don man ngag gi nyams su len pa'i tshe/ don la'ang dgos par gda' lags pa/ snang ba gsum po gang gi nang du ji ltar 'du rgyu zhib pa cig ces pa'i lan ni/ snang ba gsum po 'di lam gyi gzhi bca' la sbyor ba dang / lam yongs rdzogs la sbyor ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la yang dbang po brtul po la rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ gso sbyong nas bde mchog sgyu ma'i bar ther chags su dkri ba dang / snang ba dang po dkri tshul tsam sngon du song nas/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i bar ci rigs pa la dkri ba dang / de lta bu'i dkri tshul rgyas shing mang ba mi dgos par snang ba dang po gnyis tsam gyi nang du so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i nyams len tshang ba la bkod nas/ de rjes kyai rdo rje brtsams pas chog pa sogs du ma yod pa las/ lam gyi gzhi bca' ba'i skabs 'dir ni snang ba gsum du dkri ba tsam du bsdus nas nyams su blangs pas chog ces pa'i don yin gyi/

gzhi bca' ba'i skabs 'dir sgyu ma bde mchog gi bar gyi dkri tshul thams cad snang ba gsum du bsdus nas nyams su len pa ni ma yin te/ de'i tshe pha rol tu phyin pa rang rkang nas bshad pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa yin pas/ rgyud sde bzhi'i nyams len gyi rim pa la ma zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang snang gsum lam yongs rdzogs la sbyor ba'i tshe ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ba nas dbang gi bar rgyu rgyud/ nyams kyi snang ba thabs rgyud/ dag pa'i snang ba 'bras rgyud du 'gyur zhing / de'i tshe ma dag pa'i snang ba'i skabs su skyes pa'i log rtog spong ba'i nyams nas brtsams te/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i bar gyi ting nge 'dzin thams cad nyams snang dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan la yid ches khyad par can skye ba yang nyams snang ngam/ 'bras bu rang gi khongs su bsdus kyang chog la/ thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i nyams la brten nas log lta spong / /lam gyi nyams kyis theg pa gcig tu bsdud/ /'bras bu'i nyams kyis spro ba mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum nyams gsum gyi nang du bsdus sgro 'dogs chod par byas nas nyams su blangs kyang chog pas na mkhas mchog smra seng gi bshad pa de rnams dang / 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam la gzhung tshom bu bdun du bshad pa re res kyang lam yongs rdzogs re bstan zhes gsungs pa ni/ kha nang du phyogs nas nyams su len pa rnams la man ngag gi gdams pa lags/ zhes gsungs 'dug lags shing / yang dka' ba'i gnad 'di rnams la gong gi dri ba po des 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba la dri ba zhus pa dang / lan mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ltar snang ste/ snang gsum du skal dman rim gyis pa'i lam gso sbyong nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes kyi bar ji ltar 'du gsungs pa/ spyir snang ba gsum gyi sgra yang par byas nas/ theg pa che chung lam 'bras bu thams cad kyang der 'du ba la dgongs nas khrid yig la lar de ltar gsungs pa yin mchis/

kho bos de 'dra'i khrid yig ma mthong / re re nas snang ba gsum po 'dir 'dus lugs bshad pa yang ma mthong zhing / bshad kyang dka' ba 'dra/ gzhung nas bshad tshod dang / rang gi go tshod la ma dag pa'i snang bar theg pa thun mong ba'i nyams len rags pa mthun/ des mtshon nas 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre bas/ thun mong ba'i nyams kyi snang bar theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len 'dus/ thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang bar sde snod gsum gyi don mtha' dag 'dus par gsungs na/ sngags kyi nyams len phal cher los 'dus mod/ 'on kyang bya spyod sogs re re nas gzhag tu mi rung / dbang la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bya spyod dang tshul mthun zhing zab/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnal 'byor rgyud dang cha mthun zab/ dbang gong ma gsum bla med spyi dang mthun cing zab tshul gzhan las gdam ngag 'di pa gsal zhing zab par bstan pa tsam la dgongs nas yin snyam/ zhes pa de dag ni gong ma'i bzhed srol bkod pa yin la/ da lam gyi dri lan mdor bsdus 'di la bdag lta bu skyes stobs kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs kyang / ring du sbyangs pa'i blo gros dman pa'i phyir nyes pa'i cha 'ga' mchis na ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen khyod kyis bsal du gsol/ 'dir smras pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po yis/ /lung dus bstan pa'i mjug 'dir skye bo rnams/ /gal chung dam pa chos kyi bya ba la/ /babs phyir 'di na dal 'byor don med mang / /sngon tshe bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin du mas ljongs 'di kun tu khyab/ /deng dus mtshan ldan bla ma khyod nyid las/ /lan brgyar btsal kyang rnyed pa'i skabs dang bral/ /kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma 'di 'dra la/ /gong ma'i rnam thar skyong 'dod gser bas dkon/ /de yi mthun rkyen nyin mo'i skar dang mtshungs/ /kyi hud 'di 'dra bsam gyin mchi ma dku/

/deng sang chos bzhin bgyid pa'i gang zag la/ /mtho dman skye bo phal cher yid sdang bas/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gnod pa'i dus kyi shugs/ /ngan pa'i tshul 'di bsam gyin skyo ba 'phel/ /des na gcig tu bstan la phan 'dod pa'i/ /mang du thos pa blo gros gsal ldan bdag /byang chub bar du yongs 'dzin khyod nyid las/ /mgon skyabs gzhan na med do dgongs par mdzod/ /gang mthong lha dang bla ma dbyer med sku/ /gang thos lha dang bla ma dbyer med gsung / /gang bsam lha dang bla ma dbyer med thugs/ /gang yang brjod bral nyid du shes pa yis/ /gnad 'dis sa lam gegs med myur bgrod de/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen mngon gyur shog /ces pa 'di ni rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa'i 'dren pa dam pa de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas mi lo sum stong bdun brgya dang zhe brgyad 'das pa'i zhe dgu pa/ da rnam dag bstan pa'i lhag ma bdun brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gcig yod pa sems lags/ a na la'i le sha ra ta'i dus kyi kirta ke'i zla ba'i rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi rang byung bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po yis dri ba'i tshul cung zad gnang ba rnams kyi lan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
